title: Stable Lift Is Regular Semisimple and Good
body_html:
Stable Lift Is Regular Semisimple and Good

Let \(\lambda\) be a stable vector in the epipelagic Moy-Prasad graded piece, and let \(\gamma\) be any lift of \(\lambda\) to the corresponding negative-depth lattice. Then \(\gamma\) is regular semisimple, and \(\gamma\) is a good element of depth \(-1/m\).
proof_html:
Extraction

The proof transports \(\lambda\) to the Kac-Vinberg eigenspace at the hyperspecial base point. Stability implies regular semisimplicity after reduction. Evaluating invariant polynomials before and after the tame base-change scaling shows the lift is regular. Root evaluations are then read off from the scaled eigenspace, giving exactly valuation \(-1/m\).

deps.title: Kac-Vinberg Grading at an Epipelagic Point
